hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom single-LP AMM backed by Euler vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes a quote using a custom invariant curve, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully intercept the swap. Concentrated liquidity and donations are intentionally blocked.
